name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Grip the pulldown bar underhand at shoulder width and sit with your thighs snug beneath the pads.
Sit upright with a slight natural lean back and let your arms extend overhead into a full lat stretch.
Pull the bar smoothly down toward your upper chest while keeping your elbows tucked in front of your body.
Extend your arms slowly back overhead under full control before starting the next repetition.
tips: Lead the pull by driving your elbows straight down toward your hips rather than curling solely with your biceps.
Keep your torso steady instead of rocking far backward to drop the stack.
